title: Mathematical novelty of the $q$-deformed uniqueness estimates
html:
Remark. Mathematical novelty of the q-deformed uniqueness estimates

These bounds follow the classical 2D Ladyzhenskaya/enstrophy methods; the novelty is that the same bounding logic lifts into the non-commutative q-deformed categorical architecture. It grounds well-posedness within the quantum group Sobolev spaces, avoiding the classical function-space pathology rather than patching it phenomenologically.
